title: Optimal Momentum Methods for Stochastic Multilevel Compositional Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.01572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper investigates stochastic multi-level optimization where the objective is a nested composition of several smooth non-convex functions. We assume that only stochastic estimates of the gradient and function values for each level are accessible. Consequently, obtaining an accurate estimate of the overall gradient is challenging due to the nested structure. To address this, we employ a momentum-based estimator with mini-batches to track the function values of each level, which are subsequently used to construct momentum gradient estimators. We establish an optimal sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4})$ for finding an $\epsilon$-stationary point, avoiding the stronger average smoothness assumption commonly relied upon in prior literature. translated_title: 随机多层复合优化的最优动量方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究随机多层优化问题，其目标函数是多个光滑非凸函数的嵌套复合。我们假设仅能获得每一层梯度和函数值的随机估计。因此，由于嵌套结构的存在，获得整体梯度的准确估计极具挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们采用基于动量的估计器并结合小批量样本来追踪每一层的函数值，进而利用这些值构建动量梯度估计器。我们建立了寻找 $\epsilon$-稳定点所需的最优样本复杂度 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4})$，并避免了先前文献中通常依赖的更强的平均光滑性假设。此外，通过采用归一化技术，我们在无需依赖问题特定常数来设置超参数的情况下达到了相同的收敛速率。为了在不使用小批量的情况下达到最优速率……
tldr: 本文针对随机多层复合优化问题提出基于动量的梯度估计方法，在无需更强平均光滑性假设、且无需依赖问题特定常数设置超参数的条件下，实现了寻找 $\epsilon$-稳定点的最优样本复杂度 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4})$。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a momentum-based gradient estimation method for stochastic multilevel compositional optimization, achieving the optimal sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4})$ for finding $\epsilon$-stationary points without relying on the stronger average smoothness assumption or problem-dependent constants for hyperparameter setting.
